name: Garni Zipferkeller
beschreibung: The Garni Zipferkeller is centrally located in Kufstein, just a few minutes' walk from the town centre and the imposing fortress. The house combines traditional Tyrolean charm with a well-kept, quiet atmosphere. Guests benefit from comfortable rooms and an extensive breakfast that includes regional products. The location is ideal for exploring the Altstadt and as a starting point for hikes in the Kaisergebirgen. Parking is available.
